cheapEat.name: Hot dog (pølse) from a pølsevogn
cheapEat.note: Grilled hot dog with toppings; Copenhagen Tourism puts it near 40 kr (Oct 2026)

CPH.saveTip: Buy beer at REMA 1000 (50 cl Tuborg about €2, plus refundable deposit) instead of about €8 in a bar.

STO.saveTip: Buy beer above 3.5% at Systembolaget rather than in bars; it shuts at 15:00 on Saturdays and all day Sunday.

GOT.saveTip: Eat your main meal at lunch: most restaurants serve a lunch menu for 90-130 kr, mostly 11:30-14:00.

cheapEat.name: Student-restaurant lunch at Unicafe
cheapEat.note: Open to non-students; set lunch with drink, bread and salad buffet, listed at €8-9.50

HEL.saveTip: Make lunch your main meal: Finnish restaurants serve lunch sets with salad bar, bread and a drink for €8-15.

TLL.saveTip: Eat a street off Raekoja plats: restaurants there offer the same food quality at lower prices.

RIX.saveTip: Get a Rimi customer card (€1 in store, or the app): many supermarket offers are only available with it.

VNO.saveTip: If a menu comes in English or German, also check the Lithuanian version; it may list lower prices.

GDN.saveTip: Eat at a bar mleczny (milk bar): Gdańsk's Neptun and Stągiewna list two courses for about 12-22 zł.

KRK.saveTip: Eat lunch at a bar mleczny (milk bar), where a soup, main and kompot meal comes to under 25 zł.

cheapEat.name: Milk bar soup and main course
cheapEat.note: Bar Prasowy: żurek 8 zł, pierogi under 15 zł; most plates under 25 zł (2026 guide)

WAW.saveTip: Look for kebab shops and Vietnamese restaurants, Warsaw's cheapest options besides milk bars.

cheapEat.name: Pierogi at Bar Pierożek
cheapEat.note: A dozen pierogi ruskie with kompot, about 28 zł (2026 guide); ul. Sądowa 7

WRO.saveTip: Eat at a bar mleczny (milk bar); at Bar Miś soup plus pork cutlet and mash is about 22 zł (2026 guide).

cheapEat.name: Milk-bar meal at Bar Pod Arkadami
cheapEat.note: One of the last milk bars in Poznań; a 2026 guide lists 12-22 zł

POZ.saveTip: Look for places named Bistro, Kebab or Bar mleczny: they serve a meal for usually about 30 zł.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst
cheapEat.note: Konnopke's sells it for about €3 (€5-6 with fries); stands run €2.50-5 (2026 guide)

BER.saveTip: Buy beer at a Späti (kiosk) and drink it outside; return the bottle for its 8-25 cent Pfand.

cheapEat.name: Fischbrötchen fish roll at the harbour
cheapEat.note: Brücke 10 harbour kiosk lists €4-7 (2026 guide); St. Pauli Fischmarkt: Sundays 05:00-09:30

HAM.saveTip: Look for weekday lunch specials (Mittagstisch): restaurants in commercial areas offer them cheaply, some with a drink.

cheapEat.name: Leberkässemmel from a butcher
cheapEat.note: Vinzenzmurr sells the Leberkäs roll for around €4 (2026 guide); butchers beat bakers

MUC.saveTip: At traditional Bavarian beer gardens you may bring your own food; you only have to buy the drinks there.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst with fries
cheapEat.note: Curry B. near Neumarkt; a 2026 guide lists currywurst with fries under €8

CGN.saveTip: Cover your glass with the coaster to stop the Köbes bringing more Kölsch; each one is added to your bill.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst at Best Worscht in Town
cheapEat.note: Curryworscht €5.50 on the chain's menu (recommended price); stands have no seating

cheapEat.name: Eierschecke cake with coffee
cheapEat.note: Dresden's three-layer quark cake; a Jan 2026 guide puts coffee and cake at €6-10

DRS.saveTip: Skip the tourist traps around the Frauenkirche; decent food costs less north of Albertplatz in Neustadt.

LEJ.saveTip: Buy Sternburg Export, one of Germany's cheapest beers, in a supermarket and return the bottle for its Pfand.

cheapEat.name: Three Nürnberger sausages in a roll
cheapEat.note: 'Drei im Weggla' snack; Bratwurstglöcklein menu dated 12 May 2026 lists €5.50

VIE.saveTip: Ask a supermarket deli counter (Feinkost) to make you a sandwich; you pay only for the ingredients.

cheapEat.name: Lángos at the Central Market Hall
cheapEat.note: Fried-dough lunch at a hall counter, 2,000 Ft in a 2026 guide

BUD.saveTip: Order the weekday napi menü (set lunch): a 2026 guide lists soup-and-main or three courses for 2,500-3,000 Ft.

BTS.saveTip: Take the weekday set lunch (denné menu), listed at about €8-10 in a 2026 Bratislava cheap-eats guide.

cheapEat.name: Raw herring (haring) from a stall
cheapEat.note: Served with onions and pickles; €3.50-4.50 in a 2026 guide, a broodje costs a bit more

AMS.saveTip: Dutch restaurants make their profit on drinks and desserts, so skip them to keep the bill down.

cheapEat.name: Frites from a fritkot
cheapEat.note: Maison Antoine's €3 is from a Nov 2022 listing; fritkots offer many sauces

BRU.saveTip: Avoid Rue des Bouchers and the Italian restaurant streets by the Grand-Place; menu prices often differ from the window.

cheapEat.name: Cod and chips from a chippy
cheapEat.note: UK average £11.41 (Seafish, Jun 2026); best-rated London chippies are in the suburbs

LON.saveTip: Buy a supermarket meal deal (sandwich, snack and drink) for lunch; most cost £3-6 as of 2025.

cheapEat.name: Haddock and chips from a chippy
cheapEat.note: UK average £10.29 (Seafish, Jun 2026); haddock is the usual Scottish fish

EDI.saveTip: Eat in value areas like Elm Row, South Bridge and Forrest Rd; the Royal Mile, Princes St and Grassmarket cost more.

cheapEat.name: Haddock and chips from a chippy
cheapEat.note: UK average £10.29 (Seafish, Jun 2026); haddock is the usual Scottish fish

GLA.saveTip: Eat and drink at Wetherspoon pubs such as The Counting House; the chain is famous for low prices.

cheapEat.name: Fish and chips from a chipper
cheapEat.note: Leo Burdock's is a classic chipper; a 2025 guide lists Dublin fish and chips at €10-14

DUB.saveTip: Have your main meal at a pub carvery lunch (roast meat, vegetables, potatoes), which is usually good value.

cheapEat.name: Bouillon starter and main course
cheapEat.note: Bouillon Pigalle: egg mayo €2.70 + sausage and mash €8.80; Chartier mains from €7

PAR.saveTip: Make lunch your main meal: virtually every Paris restaurant offers a fixed-price lunch deal.

cheapEat.name: Bouchon weekday lunch formule
cheapEat.note: La Meunière lists dish of the day €19, menu €23-26.50; set lunches run €15-22 (2026)

LYS.saveTip: Ask for a carafe d'eau: bread and tap water are free in French restaurants, so skip bottled water.

cheapEat.name: Socca chickpea pancake in Old Nice
cheapEat.note: A portion costs about €3-5 (2026 guide); Lou Pilha Leva was €2.80 in 2019

NCE.saveTip: Make lunch your main meal: Nice's lunchtime set menus give two courses, often with coffee and wine, for about €10-12.

cheapEat.name: Chichi frégi doughnut, L'Estaque
cheapEat.note: Marseille's fried doughnut; Chez Magali sells them from €2.80 (2026 guide)

MRS.saveTip: Skip bouillabaisse, which cannot be had cheaply, and order the affordable soupe de poisson instead.

cheapEat.name: Sausage at Sternen Grill
cheapEat.note: A Mar 2026 guide lists CHF 8-15 at Sternen Grill; Wikivoyage's CHF 6 dates from 2015

ZRH.saveTip: Eat in department-store cafeterias (Coop, Migros, Manor); they are usually much cheaper than restaurants.

GVA.saveTip: Buy Coop salads and sandwiches at the end of the day, when they are half price.

REK.saveTip: Drink at happy hour (about 15:00-19:00), with beer from about 770 ISK (€5.60); the Appy Hour app lists deals.
